description:
Search for fields belonging to a given field association scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The starting index of the returned fields. Base index: 0.
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of fields to return per page, maximum allowed value is 100.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: The field IDs to filter by, if empty then all fields belonging to a field association scheme will be returned
parameters.name: fieldId

parameters.description: The scheme ID to search for child fields
parameters.name: id

200.description: Returns the matching fields, at the specified page of the results.

400.description: Returned if the request parameters are invalid (e.g., negative startAt, maxResults exceeding limit, duplicate fieldIds).

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

404.description: Returned if the feature flag is disabled or the scheme ID is not found.
